summary: The candidate applies the stored hub session refresh cookie to error responses and makes the concurrent refresh expiry assertion derive both timestamps from one captured clock value. No regressions were identified in the changed files.

evidence: src/passport.ts introduces withHubSessionRefresh, reuses it on the success and catch paths, and registers the rotated token before the user lookup so store failures can still return the replacement cookie.
tests/bun_test.ts adds regression coverage for both store and static asset failures, verifying the 500 response carries a valid rotated cookie that authenticates on retry.
src/store_test.ts captures one refreshedAt timestamp for both lastUsedAt and expiresAt, removing the clock-tick race in the concurrent refresh equality assertion.
